title: Stasis Sam
description: A triptych of three sequential poses of a hairless, muscular baby wearing a white tank top and dark shorts, set against bright pink backgrounds. The artwork is displayed over a larger pink surface with the stenciled black text 'STASIS SAM' layered behind it.
prompt: A triptych artwork featuring three sequential dynamic poses of the same muscular, hairless baby character wearing a tight white tank top and dark athletic shorts. The baby is shown crouching, mid-jump, and in a fighting stance. Each panel has a solid vibrant hot pink background. The entire piece is mounted over a larger pink surface with large, bold, black stenciled text reading STASIS SAM visible behind and around the white-framed panels.
